newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: MIM says selling some transport operations.
newsitem.headline: MIM says selling some transport operations.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd said on Monday its Universal Transport Operations (UTO) unit will sell its central and southern Australian operations and concentrate on northern Australia in a restructuring move.
UTO, a wholly-owned subsidiary of MIM, was currently in negotiatons with potential buyers, MIM said.
The units for sale comprise operations at Sydney, Newcastle, Melbourne, Adelaide, Alice Springs, Darwin and Rockhampton, as well as Gladstone's freight forwarding operations, MIM said.
UTO would retain its Brisbane, Mackay, Townsville, Mount Isa and McArthur River operations, the company said.

MIM no longer required its own transport network along the entire Australian east coast and interior following the closure of the copper rod manufacturing plant at MIM's Townsville copper refinery in October, MIM said.
The refinery, now undergoing expansion, would concentrate on copper cathode production.
